title: Primal Radiance — The Burning Hunt
revision: Draft 2 / Primal Radiance classification / forked tree

classification.applies_to: existing supported tags of every Primal Radiance jutsu

emphasis.primary: Offense — Fire damage (Fire Style: Beast, Fire Style: Squirrel) and Beast's self Increase Damage Given
emphasis.secondary: Pressure — Afterburn and Increase Damage Taken (Primal Incineration)
emphasis.tertiary: Defense — Decrease Damage Taken (Fire Style: Squirrel self buff)
emphasis.rationale: Three of the six supported rows are directly offensive: the two Fire damage rows (Beast 50, Squirrel 40 at jutsu level 25) and Beast's 35% self Increase Damage Given, with the bloodline's own Fire Increase Damage Given passive multiplying them, so offense is primary and is given both a raw-power route and a buff-window route. Primal Incineration is the kit's only opener (40 AP, D-rank): its Afterburn 35% and Fire-filtered exposure 35% are single rows whose value lands on later hits the target takes, so pressure is secondary with one route. Defense is a single 30% Decrease Damage Taken self buff on Fire Style: Squirrel, realized on the caster at cast time for 2 rounds per 60 AP cast (CD 6) regardless of position; as the kit's only defensive row it is tertiary and gets one route, held to Taiyo Kami's single-row +10 shape pending the user's value decision (risk 6). Wound and move are unsupported.

nodes.name: Hunter's Brand
nodes.flavor: Every quarry the beast marks is already half-burned.
nodes.coverage_note: Incineration exposure 35→37% (Fire hits, or hits on the caster's highest offence stat; 2 rounds); Beast 50→51, Squirrel 40→41. 3 rows.

nodes.name: Fang and Ember
nodes.flavor: Teeth of ember, breath of wildfire.
nodes.coverage_note: Beast and Squirrel Fire damage rows only (51→53 and 41→43 with Hunter's Brand). Both 60 AP, range 4; Squirrel is a ground circle, CD 6.

nodes.name: Apex Conflagration
nodes.flavor: When the alpha roars, the whole forest catches.
nodes.coverage_note: The same two damage rows; the route totals +6 power (Beast 50→56, Squirrel 40→46) before the bloodline's Fire damage passive.

nodes.name: Smoldering Trail
nodes.flavor: Where the hunted beast ran, the ground still smolders.
nodes.coverage_note: Primal Incineration Afterburn only (one 2-round enemy debuff, 40 AP, CD 7): 35→38%. Value lands on every non-pierce hit the target takes.

nodes.name: Pyre of the Hunted
nodes.flavor: The hunt ends on a pyre the prey built with its own flight.
nodes.coverage_note: Incineration Afterburn 38→45% and exposure 37→40% with Hunter's Brand; one 40 AP cast carries both for 2 rounds on one target.

nodes.name: Hide and Fang
nodes.flavor: Thick pelt, sharp fang, both lit from within.
nodes.coverage_note: Squirrel self Decrease Damage Taken 30→32% (on the caster at cast time, 2 rounds, any position); Beast self Increase Damage Given 35→37%.

nodes.name: Radiant Hide
nodes.flavor: A hide that drinks the flame it stands in.
nodes.coverage_note: Squirrel Decrease Damage Taken only (element-less row, all four stat types: every non-pierce hit): 32→35% with Hide and Fang.

nodes.name: Den of Embers
nodes.flavor: Within the burning den, nothing reaches the beast.
nodes.coverage_note: Squirrel self Decrease Damage Taken 35→40% (the +10 route ceiling; 2 rounds per 60 AP cast) and Beast Increase Damage Given 37→39%.

nodes.name: Kindled Fury
nodes.flavor: Fury stoked until the blood itself glows.
nodes.coverage_note: Beast Increase Damage Given only (self, 2 rounds per 60 AP cast; Fire hits or hits on the caster's highest stat): 37→40% with Hide and Fang.

nodes.name: Primal Rampage
nodes.flavor: The radiant beast unbound, and nothing left to hold it.
nodes.coverage_note: Beast Increase Damage Given 40→45% (the +10 route ceiling) and Squirrel self Decrease Damage Taken 32→34%.

examples.name: Apex Conflagration
examples.rationale: The +6 power route on both Fire attacks (Beast 50→56, Squirrel 40→46 before the bloodline's Fire Increase Damage Given passive multiplies them) with Hunter's Brand's 37% exposure. Hide and Fang is the fourth purchase so Beast's self buff reaches 37% and Squirrel's self DDT 32%; Smoldering Trail (Afterburn 38%) is the all-pressure alternative.

examples.name: Pyre of the Hunted
examples.rationale: One 40 AP Primal Incineration cast marks a target with 45% Afterburn and 40% exposure for 2 rounds: every non-pierce hit it then takes (Beast, Squirrel, normal jutsu, weapons, allies) adds 45% Afterburn damage up to the 60% per-hit cap, and Fire hits, plus hits whose resolved stat type equals the caster's highest offence stat (e.g. the caster's basic attacks), are amplified a further 40%. Attacks sit at 51 and 41. Hide and Fang adds Beast 37% and Squirrel DDT 32%; Fang and Ember (attacks 53 / 43) is the sharper alternative.

examples.name: Den of Embers
examples.rationale: The beast as its own stronghold: each 60 AP Squirrel cast (CD 6) puts 40% Decrease Damage Taken on the caster at cast time for 2 rounds, on every non-pierce hit and regardless of where anyone stands, with Beast's self buff at 39%. Hunter's Brand keeps the enemy-facing face alive (exposure 37%, attacks 51 / 41); Kindled Fury (Beast 42%) is the all-self alternative that stays under one root.

examples.name: Primal Rampage
examples.rationale: Beast's self Increase Damage Given at 45% for the 2 rounds after each 60 AP cast, multiplying Squirrel and every other Fire hit plus basic attacks and any weapon or jutsu hit whose resolved stat type is the caster's highest offence stat (fixed-stat non-Fire hits of another stat are excluded), with Squirrel's self DDT at 34%. Hunter's Brand gives the setup cast a 37% exposure to stack the window on; Radiant Hide (DDT 37%) is the sturdier alternative fourth purchase.

design_notes: Node split: the roots mirror the kit's two faces. Hunter's Brand (enemy-facing: Incineration exposure plus both Fire damage rows) forks into Fang and Ember → Apex Conflagration (raw damage) and Smoldering Trail → Pyre of the Hunted (burn). Hide and Fang (self-facing: Squirrel circle DDT plus Beast IDG) forks into Radiant Hide → Den of Embers (defense) and Kindled Fury → Primal Rampage (buff window). 2 F / 4 H / 4 A; every capstone 3 BP deep; two capstones cost 5 or 6 BP.

Flats scale by coverage, not rank. Damage reaches 2 rows (Taiyo: 3): route +6, Beast 50→56, Squirrel 40→46. Afterburn +10 (35→45%). Increase Damage Taken is one Fire-filtered row at +5 (35→40%), under Taiyo's +7. DDT and IDG are single self-buff rows on Taiyo's 2/3/5 shape (+10 each). On the two self routes each capstone's +2 secondary is one below the sibling Hidden Art's +3 on that tag; Pyre (IDT +3) and Apex have no such pair. Non-dominance (14/14) is the audit's finding, not this rule's.

Passives: the Fire IDG passive (15 + 0.15/lvl; bloodline sources multiply) scales the Fire damage rows. Beast's IDG (jutsu-sourced; Fire, stat Highest) boosts for 2 rounds the caster's Fire hits, basic attacks and hits resolving to the caster's highest offence stat; other fixed-stat non-Fire hits are excluded. Incineration's exposure covers the same classes (stat compared: the debuff caster's, §4b); Afterburn covers every non-pierce hit. Squirrel's element-less DDT covers nearly every hit.

Delivery and uptime: Primal Incineration is 40 AP, CD 7, single target; both debuffs last 2 rounds per cast. Beast is 60 AP, CD 7, single target; its self buff lasts 2 rounds. Squirrel is 60 AP, CD 6, an EMPTY_GROUND circle, but its DDT row has target SELF, so it is realized on the caster at cast time for 2 rounds (SOURCE_MECHANICS.md §4b, actions.ts 980-1004): not a ground effect, no positioning condition, no leak to allies or enemies. Only Squirrel's damage row is positional.

Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) → Hide and Fang (Squirrel DDT 32%, Beast 37%) or Smoldering Trail (Afterburn 38%); Burn (01,04,05) → Hide and Fang or Fang and Ember (attacks 53 / 43); Fortified (06,07,08) → Hunter's Brand (exposure 37%, attacks 51 / 41) or Kindled Fury (Beast 42%); Buff window (06,09,10) → Hunter's Brand or Radiant Hide (DDT 37%). Six no-Advanced hybrids: 01,02,04,06; 01,02,06,07; 01,02,06,09; 01,04,06,07; 01,04,06,09; 01,06,07,09. All 14 full allocations are non-dominated.

Row-weighted scale (Σ flat × rows reached): 01,02,04,05 and the Burn build 01,04,05,06 score 21 (3.5 per row); Burst, Fortified and Buff window 18; median 17 (2.8). Taiyo Kami's 14 full builds span 16–31 on 9 rows (max 3.4 per row, median 20.5 = 2.3), so this C-rank tree sits at Taiyo's per-row ceiling; its single-row IDG reaches +10 against Taiyo's per-tag IDG max of +5. Values unchanged pending the user's decision (risk 6). Lowest nodes: Smoldering Trail, Radiant Hide, Kindled Fury (3 each).
risks: Classification: Fire sits on rows of 29 other census bloodlines, so the label is the bloodline-keyed extension 'Primal Radiance' (proposed whole-kit resolver plus a classification extension). With ['Fire'] today, 4 of 6 rows match directly; the two element-less rows (Afterburn, Squirrel DDT) fall back to None, which also reaches other non-elemental jutsu. Normal-jutsu Fire collisions unverified.

Afterburn: Pyre of the Hunted puts Incineration's Afterburn at 45% for 2 rounds on one target. Every non-pierce hit it takes (kit, normal jutsu, weapons, allies) adds floor(damage × 45%), cumulative Afterburn per hit capped at 60% of the hit, so it saturates alongside other Afterburn sources. BATTLE_TAG_STACKING is on at the pin. Not a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.

Exposure: Incineration's IDT row has elements ['Fire'], stat Highest; a non-empty element list pushes no 'None' (SOURCE_MECHANICS.md §3), so it amplifies Fire hits plus hits resolving to the debuff caster's highest offence stat (realizeTag copies the caster's highestOffence, §4b): the caster's basic attacks match, an ally's non-Fire hit only on that stat. Pierce excluded. Max +5 (40%), 2 rounds.

IDG scope: Beast's self buff (Fire, stat Highest) multiplies for 2 rounds the caster's Fire hits, basic attacks and any weapon or jutsu hit resolving to the caster's highest offence stat, so Primal Rampage's 45% is window-wide, not kit-only; other fixed-stat non-Fire hits are excluded. Jutsu-sourced, additive with other jutsu/skill modifiers; the Fire passive multiplies on top. Pierce excluded.

DDT delivery: Squirrel's DDT row has target SELF on an EMPTY_GROUND spawn. Per SOURCE_MECHANICS.md §4b a SELF row on a ground action is realized on the caster at cast time, not through the tiles: it lands for 2 rounds, needs no positioning and leaks to nobody. Den of Embers' 40% has plain 2-rounds-per-cast uptime (60 AP, CD 6), like Beast's IDG; its +10 ceiling is a user decision (risk 6).

Value decisions (user-owned): IDG and DDT both reach +10 on single unconditional 2-round self buffs (Beast 45%, Squirrel 40%), Damage +6 on 2 rows, Afterburn +10; strongest build 21/6 rows (3.5 per row), at Taiyo Kami's 31/9 ceiling (note 6). C-rank bloodline; the brief adjusts by coverage, not rank. Lowering the self-buff routes to 2/3/4 (+9) is the ready alternative. No combat simulation.

Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling) and then multiplied by the Fire Increase Damage Given passive, so +6 raw power is not a linear +6 damage. Squirrel's damage row is an area hit with friendly fire ENEMIES (no ally hazard); Beast's wound 25% and Squirrel's move are unsupported and receive nothing.

Context not modelled: the bloodline's +10% Increase Damage Taken passive on Water (a standing weakness) is untouched by any node; skill-tree and bloodline effects are suppressed in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING at the pin, so no Bloodright node applies there. Main-tree effects, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

audit.revision: Draft 2 / Primal Radiance classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.
All existing supported tags of Primal Radiance jutsu inherit Primal Radiance potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.
Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.
